selection.description: Quota 1 GPA floor of 5.0 on the Danish scale.

officialRequirementsText.text: In addition you must have passed: English level B. Mathematics level A. Physics level B or Geoscience level A. Course levels refer to the Danish high school system: A is advanced, B is intermediate, and C is beginner level.

notes: Non-EU tuition at institution level: Set per programme and paid a full year in advance: EUR 17,300 per year for the engineering and IT programmes (Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Electronics, Engineering Innovation and Business, Interactive Technology Engineering, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, and the three BEng programmes) and EUR 15,000 per year for European Studies, Economics and Business Administration (Sønderborg) and Market and Management Anthropology. Application fee EUR 200 per applicant regardless of how many programmes you apply for. EU/EEA and Swiss citizens pay nothing.

Which IB award opens this one is NOT established. The national rule turns on the kind of programme: DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three at HL, reach erhvervsakademi- and professionsbacheloruddannelser on their own, while a universitetsbacheloruddannelse needs supplementary hf-enkeltfag on top. This is a diplomingeniør, which is a professional bachelor degree awarded by a university, and no source read here says which of the two admission orders it is admitted under — the Agency's IB guidance names programme types, not this hybrid. It is therefore left unrecorded rather than guessed, and a Course candidate is told so. Establishing it needs SDU admissions, or the scope clause of bekendtgørelsen om adgang til erhvervsakademiuddannelser og professionsbacheloruddannelser, in writing.
